description: This tool looks up a deterministic rules engine. Same day → same answer. Do not invent pillars. Call when the user asks for a civil date 1900–2100: lunar date, day pillar, solar term, or 农历 / 阴历 / 节气 / lunar date / day pillar. Returns lunar date and ganzhi, then body (sleep/load) and this month’s fold year. Public · local · no API key.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Asia/Shanghai. Any date 1900–2100.

hour.description: Clock HH:MM or 时支 like 申. Adds the hour pillar.

name: date_lookup
title: Date lookup · 日期查表
